Name: Ani's Color collection
Author: GrannyAni
Description:
[center][size=3]

[/size][size=6][b]Ani's Color Collection[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][/center][left][size=3]This mod adds 173 new shirts into Stardew Valley using FashionSense. All clothing contained within this mod has been designed and colored by myself (optional files are an exception). With 6 colors to choose from and the ability to change some of the colors I hope this pack provides enough variety for most players! This pack has been designed to fit both masculine and feminime styles, mainly because I thought there weren't many mods that added masculine styles into the game, so I tried creating some of my own![/size]


[size=3][/size][size=5]Download information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]If not already done, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] on your device[/size]
[*][size=3]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], since this is a fashion sense pack[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the relevant files from this mod page, and then unzip the files into your mods folder[/size]
[*][size=3]If these steps have been done correctly, run the game as normal and it should work! [/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Notes and other information
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]This mod can only be found on Nexus mods, if you find it uploaded anywhere else, please inform me and don't download this mod from any other websites.[/size]
[*][size=3]Most of the pants and skirts in the screenshots are the vanilla default pants and the pleated skirt. The only ones which are not either of those are any white pants/skirts you see, those are the recolored versions of the vanilla pants and skirts.[/size]
[*][size=3]If you are trying to match the color of the shirt to the pants (like how it is shown in the screenshot) colorpick the lightest/main color from the shirt and use the color sliders to match it up[/size]
[*][size=3]The recolored version of the pants and skirts are included in the optional file section, this is because I wanted to separate outfits that I drew myself (main mod) and ones that are simply recolored (additional files)[/size]
[*][size=3]If you download the optional files follow the above steps and DO NOT put the optional files in the main file, they are both standalone folders.[/size]
[*][size=3]If the amount of colors are overwhelming/you are interested in only a few outfits, you can delete some of the folders in the mod to reduce the amount of shirts.[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Credits
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]A big thanks to the Stardew valley discord for helping me whenever I had questions[/size]
[*][size=3]Thank you to my friends who bug tested this mod and listened to me whenever I talked about this mod[/size]
[*][size=3]A really big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/120958053]Violetlizabet[/url]﻿ for creating the tools I needed to add the optional files, without her I wouldn't have been able to do it[/size]
[*][size=3]Vanilla pants and pleated skirt were created by ConcernedApe [/size]
[/list][/left][size=3]
[/size]
